boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus spaces for studying, recreation, arts, and low-key time together, grounded in current SMCM sources.

cards.title: Hilda C. Landers Library
cards.subtitle: Library and group-study space across from Campus Center
cards.notes: Bring a partner for a work session: the library offers social spaces and group study rooms, plus computers, scanning, copying, and printing.
cards.short_summary: A practical campus stop for collaborative work, research tasks, and computer access.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM identifies Landers Library as Building 23 across from Campus Center; its services include study rooms and computer, scanner, copier, and printer access.
cards.source_title: Library Services | St. Mary's College of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Library services are described for students, staff, alumni, and local patrons; confirm room availability before heading over.

cards.title: Cole Cinema
cards.subtitle: Campus Center movie theater
cards.notes: Check the campus events calendar for screenings or talks, then find the theater down the hallway from the Campus Center Information Desk.
cards.short_summary: A 100-plus-seat campus theater used for student movie screenings and lectures.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM says Cole Cinema is a 100+ seat theater inside Campus Center that hosts free student movie screenings and lectures by professors and guest speakers.
cards.source_title: Campus Hangouts | St. Mary's College of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Individual events may have their own schedules or requirements; review the event listing before attending.

cards.title: The Waterfront
cards.subtitle: St. Mary's River shoreline and recreation area
cards.notes: Plan a daytime river outing: students can use the beach and wading area or check out listed water equipment for recreational use.
cards.short_summary: A campus riverfront for beach time and student water recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM states that students have free daily recreational access to kayaks, stand-up paddle boards, windsurfing equipment, and FJ sailboats at the Waterfront.
cards.source_title: Campus Hangouts | St. Mary's College of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Use water equipment only under current Waterfront procedures and conditions; SMCM describes the equipment access as free for students.

cards.title: The Greens
cards.subtitle: Communal lawn by the townhouses
cards.notes: Meet outside with a Frisbee, blanket, or yoga mat; this townhouse-area lawn also includes The Pillow and the Admission Fields.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor communal area for informal recreation and campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM describes The Greens by the townhouses as a communal space for Frisbee, blankets, and yoga mats, and says it includes The Pillow and Admission Fields.
cards.source_title: Campus Hangouts | St. Mary's College of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Outdoor use depends on weather and any scheduled campus event activity.

cards.title: Waring Commons Fire Pit
cards.subtitle: Outdoor fire pit near Waring Commons apartments
cards.notes: If hosting an approved small gathering, follow residence-life fire guidance: stay nearby while lit and fully extinguish the fire before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A named residential outdoor gathering feature with published safety requirements.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM Residence Life identifies an outdoor fire pit centrally located near the Waring Commons apartments and gives supervision and extinguishing requirements.
cards.source_title: For Students in Residence Halls and Suites | SMCM
cards.access_notes: Follow Residence Life fire rules and request a fire extinguisher from Physical Plant before hosting events, as the College directs.

cards.title: MPOBARC Climbing Wall
cards.subtitle: Michael P. O'Brien Athletics & Recreation Center
cards.notes: Look for open climbs or instructional sessions at the ARC; the climbing wall has routes intended for a range of skill levels.
cards.short_summary: An indoor climbing facility supporting open climbs, instruction, and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM says its Climbing Wall supports open climbs, instructional sessions, and general student recreation, with routes for a variety of skill levels.
cards.source_title: Fitness & Recreation | St. Mary's College of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Check current ARC programming and facility access procedures before visiting.

cards.title: North Field
cards.subtitle: Club-sports and recreation field
cards.notes: Coordinate with a club or recreation group for rugby, ultimate frisbee, or archery practice rather than treating the field as an unscheduled drop-in area.
cards.short_summary: A campus field used for club-sport practices, training, and recreational activity.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM says North Field supports practices and training for men's and women's rugby, ultimate frisbee, and archery.
cards.source_title: Fitness & Recreation | St. Mary's College of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Use should align with current club, recreation, and field-scheduling guidance.

cards.title: Dwight Frederic Boyden Gallery
cards.subtitle: Montgomery Hall, second floor
cards.notes: Stop in during posted gallery hours to see current work, then use an exhibition or event as a reason to bring a classmate along.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery and collection space for exhibitions and arts engagement.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM locates the Dwight Frederic Boyden Gallery in Montgomery Hall and says the gallery and collection support engagement across the liberal arts.
cards.source_title: Boyden Gallery | St. Mary's College of Maryland
cards.access_notes: SMCM lists gallery hours as Tuesday–Friday 11–6 and Saturday 11–4; check for exhibition-specific changes.

cards.title: Kate Chandler Campus Community Farm
cards.subtitle: Student-run farm near Route 5 and Mattapany Road
cards.notes: Connect with the farm to join planting, harvesting, or learning activities; it is run by students and grows produce and herbs for campus dining.
cards.short_summary: A student-run farm combining food production, hands-on learning, and campus community work.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM says the Kate Chandler Campus Farm is a student-run organization overseeing produce and herb planting and harvesting for campus dining.
cards.source_title: Campus Farm | St. Mary's College of Maryland
cards.access_notes: The College places the farm near Route 5 and Mattapany Road; contact the Office of Sustainability or farm organizers before participating.

cards.title: James P. Muldoon River Center
cards.subtitle: Campus waterfront recreation hub
cards.notes: Use the River Center as the check-in point for organized waterfront recreation, and confirm current equipment procedures before planning a river outing.
cards.short_summary: A named campus waterfront facility connected with recreational water sports.
cards.evidence_claim: SMCM's campus map lists the James P. Muldoon River Center, and the College describes the Waterfront and River Center as home to recreational water sports.
cards.access_notes: The campus map confirms the River Center's location; follow current Waterfront staff directions for recreation access.
